Senses.PreferredTarget: one fails and two is not it
Senses.Note: Two independent recorded-sayings sources carry the pair: Yunmen uses it to answer a question about the transmission outside the three vehicles, and Jinsu Zhi sets it in a verse; the pair also appears in transmission-record recensions.

Occurrences.Kwic: 問：「如何是三乘教外別傳底事？」師云：「你若不問，我即不答。你若問，我即朝到西天，暮歸唐土。」僧云：「乞師指示。」師云：「一不成，二不是。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J23/J23nB134.xml). Recorded Sayings of the Five Houses (Selections). Yunmen Wenyan is the direct speaker in the question-and-answer exchange; the headword is his answer to the monk's request for instruction.

Occurrences.Kwic: 僧問：「昔日靈鷲，今日菩提，未審是同？是別？」師云：「一不成，二不是。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J33/J33nB280.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yunwai Xingze of Shending, residence at Puti temple in Qizhou: asked whether the old Vulture Peak and today’s Puti are the same or different, Yunwai Xingze answers with the paired refusal.

Occurrences.Kwic: 進云：「今朝吹玉管，幾箇是知音？」師云：「一不成，二不是。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J39/J39nB450.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Minshu, residence at Taiping temple in Pengshui: asked, with the jade flute played that day, how many truly know its sound, Minshu Ruxiang answers with the paired refusal.

Occurrences.Kwic: 一不成，二不是，火雲堆裏秋風起。堪笑耘田車水翁，手脚忙亂同兒戲。

Occurrences.Kwic: 總不恁麼，錯！錯！上堂：吞却乾坤大地，開口何處出氣？永嘉一宿曹溪，至今猶未瞥地。上堂：十目視，十手指。一不成，二不是。會麼？寒鷹未舉首，俊󳬲已冲霄。僧問：昔年雲外人皆委，今日當場略借看。曰：山僧愛嗔不愛喜？云：斬新日月，特地乾坤。曰：恰似不相逢。

Occurrences.Kwic: 塔主：祇如塔中和尚得第幾句？主無對。師曰：你問我。主便問。師曰：不快即道。主曰：作麼生是不快即道？師曰：一不成，二不是。問直歲：甚處去來？曰：刈茆來。師曰：刈得幾箇祖師？曰：三百箇。師曰：朝打三千，暮打八百。東家杓柄長，西家杓柄短。又作麼生？

Occurrences.Kwic: 師曰：森羅萬象，明暗色空，日夜舉揚。趙州古佛，不是不知，只為貪程。速急！上堂：楊岐眼中睛，臨濟頂中髓，一不成，二不是，點著不來，白雲萬里佛成道。上堂：錯！錯！六載草繩空自縛。了！了！開得眼來天大曉。古今天地，古今日月，古今星辰。拍膝云：劒去久矣，切忌刻舟。

Occurrences.Kwic: 曰：祇如三聖道，你恁麼為人，瞎却鎮州一城人眼，又作麼生？師曰：錦上鋪華又一重。問：行脚逢人時如何？師曰：一不成，二不是。曰：行脚不逢人時如何？師曰：虎咬大蟲。曰：祇如慈明道釣絲絞水，意作麼生？師曰：水浸鋼石卵。問：三聖道：我逢人即出，出則不為

Senses.Explanation: The records use this paired refusal as a compact answer and as a line in formal addresses: the first count does not succeed, and the second is not right either. Yunmen answers a request concerning the transmission with the paired refusal. Jinsu Zhi opens a verse with the same line. The phrase itself supplies no positive third member.
